# API reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @openverify/docs-tools docs:catalog` (packages/docs-tools/src/catalog/); do not edit by hand. -->

The OpenAPI 3.1 document is [openapi.json](openapi.json) (401 paths, 501 operations), generated from the routes' zod schemas. This page adds what the document does not carry: each route's scope (its `config.scopes`, read from the routes as the API registers them), whether it takes an `Idempotency-Key`, whether it is paginated, and the rate policies the rate-limit plugin binds to it.

- **Scope**: the API-key scopes the route requires (any one of them); `public`: no credential; `flow session`: the flow session token; `in the handler`: the route declares no `config.scopes`, needs an API key or a console session, and checks any scope it needs in its handler (see the operation's description in openapi.json); `not read`: no registered route was found for the documented operation.
- **Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer` with an API key or a console user session, or a flow session token on the flow routes; see [API keys](../settings/api-keys.md).

## Versions, idempotency and pagination

- **`OpenVerify-Version`** (request and response header): The API version to serve. Without it the API key’s `api-version` applies, and a dashboard user session gets the latest version. A version the API does not support answers 400 `https://openverify.dev/problems/unsupported-api-version`. Versions: `2026-10-01`.
- **`Idempotency-Key`**: Makes the request safe to retry for 24 hours. The same key with the same request replays the stored answer, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The key with another request answers 422 `https://openverify.dev/problems/idempotency-key-reused`; while the first request still runs, 409 `https://openverify.dev/problems/idempotency-key-in-use`. A 5xx answer is not stored, so a retry runs the request again. The column "Idempotency-Key" below says which operations accept it.
- **Pagination**: the page parameters the document declares are `page[after]`, `page[before]`, `page[size]`; the column "Paginated" says which operations take one.
- **Rate limits**: a response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` for the tightest limit that applied; over a limit the request answers 429 with `Retry-After`. When the limiter is unavailable the plugin-bound policies fail open (C12).

## Rate policies

41 policies (`RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES`, with `RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULTS` and `RATE_LIMIT_POLICY_WINDOWS`, `@openverify/contracts`). The rate-limit plugin binds the first group to routes by prefix or by route, as the table above names them. Every other policy is applied by a call in a handler or a service, and no table maps a route to it, so it is listed here with its limit and window only (a per-route declaration is 11F's, `fix-server`).

| Policy | Default limit | Window | Bound by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | 300 | a minute | the rate-limit plugin |
| `flow-handoffs` | 5 | an hour | the rate-limit plugin |
| `flow-handoffs-ip` | 10 | an hour | the rate-limit plugin |
| `flow-integrity` | 5 | an hour | the rate-limit plugin |
| `flow-ip` | 600 | a minute | the rate-limit plugin |

| `one-time-link-redeem` | 30 | a minute | the rate-limit plugin |
| `account-export` | 10 | an hour | a handler or service (no route table) |
| `analytics` | 60 | a minute | a handler or service (no route table) |

## Problems

Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document (`application/problem+json`), the `ProblemInput` schema of the document:

| Member | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `status` | integer | yes |
| `detail` | string | yes |
| `instance` | string | yes |
| `requestId` | string | yes |
| `errors` | array | - |
| `code` | string | - |
| `reason` | see the schema | - |
| `stack` | string | - |

Routes declare no problem codes, so this page has no per-route problem column (review F18; declaring them is deferred, C286): each tag's section links its family's page, which describes the resources and, where it lists them, their problem codes.
